verdict.rationale: Unstructured can be driven headlessly. Its Python SDK and REST API (callable from cURL) let you create and run workflows and trigger jobs, monitor their status, and download results. A community report also says the official Docker image self-hosts with little hassle. However, no CI-specific integration or guidance is documented, so the CI part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented CI usage (e.g., GitHub Actions or pipeline examples), an official CLI for scripted runs, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can call the Unstructured API with the Unstructured Python SDK and with standard REST clients (such as cURL and Postman).
Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.
Build and manage Unstructured workflows with the Python SDK or REST endpoints. Create, update, run, and delete workflows that process and transform documents from source to destination.
The sample scripts also handle multiple files in a directory, which you can try later with your own files.
